checks.text: The page shows the heading "URL Encoder".
With the "Codec" select set to "URL encode", typing "hello world" in the "Input" field shows "hello%20world" in the "Output" field.
With the "Codec" select set to "URL encode", typing "a/b?c=d&e" in the "Input" field shows "a%2Fb%3Fc%3Dd%26e" in the "Output" field.
With the "Codec" select set to "URL decode", typing "hello%20world" in the "Input" field shows "hello world" in the "Output" field.
With the "Codec" select set to "Base64", typing "abc" in the "Input" field shows "YWJj" in the "Output" field.
With the "Codec" select set to "Hex", typing "abc" in the "Input" field shows "616263" in the "Output" field.
Clicking the "Copy" button shows a toast with the text "Copied to clipboard".
Clicking the "Add to history" button adds a row to the "History" table containing "hello world" and "hello%20world". Clicking the "Remove" button on that row removes it.
Reload keeps the history row containing "hello world" and "hello%20world".
